### WP2 — Database Migrations ✅

**New files** (V1 never modified — Flyway rule honored):

#### `V2__Fix_Core_Security.sql`
- `users.account_status`: Removed DEFAULT; added CHECK `IN ('ACTIVE','PENDING_CONSENT','SUSPENDED')` (D6)
- `mfa_factors.type`: Added CHECK `IN ('TOTP')` (D1)
- `guardian_consents.status`: Added CHECK `IN ('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED','EXPIRED')`
- `guardian_consents` audit fields added: `token_hash CHAR(64)`, `token_expires_at DATETIME`, `resend_count INT DEFAULT 0`, `last_sent_at DATETIME`, `approved_ip VARCHAR(45)` (D2)
- New table `mfa_attempts(attempt_id, user_id FK, success BOOLEAN, ip VARCHAR(45), created_at)` with composite index `(user_id, created_at)` for rate-limit queries (H6)

#### `V3__Question_And_Ai_Schema.sql`
- `questions` table: NO `is_bookmarked` column (D7)
- `question_bookmarks` with UNIQUE(profile_id, question_id) (D7)
- `ai_generation_logs`: `profile_id FK NOT NULL`, `model_id`, `prompt_version`, `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `latency_first_token_ms`, `latency_total_ms`
- `answers` with `ai_log_id FK NULL`
- `question_attachments`

#### `V4__Quiz_Schema.sql`
- `practice_quizzes`, `quiz_questions` (with `correct_answer` server-only column, D8), `quiz_options`, `quiz_attempts`, `quiz_responses`
- Full FK and ON DELETE CASCADE/RESTRICT constraints
- Proper indexes on FK columns and time-based queries

### WP3 — JPA Entities & Repositories ✅

**All entities**:
- UUID fields: `@JdbcTypeCode(SqlTypes.VARCHAR)` + `@Column(length = 36)` (fixes B2)
- TEXT fields: `columnDefinition = "TEXT"` only, no `@Lob` (fixes B2)
- No `isBookmarked` field on `Question.java` (D7)
- `AccountStatus.java`: `ACTIVE`, `PENDING_CONSENT`, `SUSPENDED` only (D6)
- `MfaType.java`: `TOTP` only (D1)
- `ConsentStatus.java`: `PENDING`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `EXPIRED`
- `MfaFactor.java`: `secret` column `length=512` to hold AES-GCM ciphertext

**New entities**: `MfaAttempt`, `PracticeQuiz`, `QuizQuestion`, `QuizOption`, `QuizAttempt`, `QuizResponse`, `QuizStatus`, `QuizQuestionType`

**New repositories**: `MfaAttemptRepository`, `QuestionRepository`, `AnswerRepository`, `QuestionBookmarkRepository`, `AiGenerationLogRepository`, `PracticeQuizRepository`, `QuizQuestionRepository`, `QuizOptionRepository`, `QuizAttemptRepository`, `QuizResponseRepository`

**Test authored**: `FlywaySchemaValidationIntegrationTest.java` (Testcontainers + `ddl-auto=validate` — requires Docker on local machine to run)

### WP4 — Configuration & Environment ✅

**`application.yml`**:
- NO hardcoded defaults for: `JWT_SECRET`, `DB_PASSWORD`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_MODEL`, `GEMINI_API_VERSION`, `MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY`
- Token lifetimes from env: `JWT_ACCESS_EXPIRATION_MS` (15min), `JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRATION_MS` (7d), `JWT_MFA_SESSION_EXPIRATION_MS` (5min) (D4)
- Actuator: `health` endpoint only

**`application-dev.yml`**:
- Clearly marked "NEVER FOR PRODUCTION"
- Dev-only values (Mailpit, local MySQL, etc.)

**`backend/docker-compose.yml`**:
- No `version:` key (deprecated)
- MySQL non-root user `studymentor_app`
- Redis with `requirepass ${REDIS_PASSWORD}`
- Mailpit container for email dev (D2)
- All ports bound to `127.0.0.1` (no unintended exposure)

**`backend/.env.example`**:
- No inline comments (B4)
- `GEMINI_MODEL=<SET_ME>`, `GEMINI_API_VERSION=<SET_ME>` (D3)
- `MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY=<SET_ME>` (H6)

**`JwtTokenProvider.java`**:
- `@PostConstruct init()` fails fast if `JWT_SECRET` < 32 bytes
- JTI (`UUID.randomUUID().toString()`) added to all tokens (H2)

### WP5 — Security Fixes ✅

| Fix | Implementation |
|---|---|
| H1: Account status from DB | `AccountStatusService.java` — Redis TTL 60s; loads from DB on cache miss; `invalidateCache()` called on consent approval |
| H2: JTI on all tokens | `JwtTokenProvider.generateAccessToken()`, `generateMfaSessionToken()`, `generateRefreshToken()` — all include `jti` claim |
| H4/D5: Standard error structure | `ErrorResponse.java` {status, error, code, message, timestamp, path}; `CustomAccessDeniedHandler.java`; `RestAuthenticationEntryPoint.java` updated |
| H4/D5: Error code mapping | 401 = missing/invalid/expired token; 403 = `GUARDIAN_CONSENT_REQUIRED`, `ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED`, `MFA_REQUIRED` |
| H5: Whitelist expansion | `GuardianConsentEnforcementFilter` permits: `/auth/**`, `/consent/**`, `/profile/*/consent-status`, `/error`, `/actuator/**`; enforces `SUSPENDED` → 403 `ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED` |
| H6: MFA rate limit | `MfaRateLimitService.java` — 5 failures / 15 min per user OR per IP → locked; `mfa_attempts` DB audit |
| H6: TOTP secret encryption | `AesGcmEncryptionUtil.java` — AES-256-GCM; key from `MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY` env |
| D3: AI fail fast | `GeminiAdapterService.validateAiConfiguration()` → `AiNotConfiguredException`; `GlobalExceptionHandler` → 503 `AI_NOT_CONFIGURED` |
| D9: U13 validation | `AgeAndGuardianEmailValidator.java` — guardianEmail mandatory if age < 13 at registration; must differ from student email |
| D8: Password max 72 bytes | `RegisterRequest` — `@Size(max = 72)` with byte-length note (bcrypt limit) |
| H9: Actuator | `spring-boot-starter-actuator` in `pom.xml`; SecurityConfig permits `/actuator/health` |

**Unit tests**: `SecurityRulesUnitTest.java` — 7 tests covering D5 error code rules, U13 blocking, MFA rate-limit, RegisterRequest validation.

### WP7 — Build Verification ⚠️ Needs PO's Local Machine

**Docker and Maven are not available in the CI sandbox**. The following steps must be executed by PO on a local machine:

```bash
# 1. Start infrastructure
cd backend
cp .env.example .env
# Fill in .env with dev values from application-dev.yml
docker compose up -d

# 2. Build & test
./mvnw clean verify

# 3. Verify Flyway migrations applied
docker exec -it aistudymentor-mysql-1 mysql -u studymentor_app -p aistudymentor \
  -e "SELECT version, description, success FROM flyway_schema_history ORDER BY installed_rank;"
```

**Expected**: All 4 migrations (V1–V4) show `success = 1`.  
**Integration test**: `FlywaySchemaValidationIntegrationTest` — Testcontainers spins MySQL, runs Flyway, Hibernate validates schema. Requires Docker daemon on the test runner.
